saw_lines: Fans buy a kit for one season, then replace it when the team changes, so each buyer decides from scratch.
So a new buyer decides in seconds, and the shipping terms have to be visible before they leave the page.
Your site offers free shipping over €120 and 30% off. Put the €120 shipping line first in your 37 Google creatives, then test it against a Pro football headline.
